justification: The class is a simple delegator wrapper with a single responsibility: adding AutoCloseable functionality to URLConnection. It has minimal state (one field), no complex logic, and all methods are one-line delegations. The class is already appropriately decomposed and focused.

The class is small and focused, with only two fields (name, moduleNames) and corresponding getters/setters. It implements a single, clear abstraction (module opens directive) without excessive responsibilities. The methods are primarily generated boilerplate (accept, clone, replace, type-casting helpers) and do not indicate bloated interface or lack of decomposition.

The class is well-decomposed, inheriting core functionality from CallableDeclaration and implementing focused interfaces (NodeWithBlockStmt, NodeWithAccessModifiers, etc.). It has a single primary responsibility (representing a constructor), minimal unique fields (only 'body'), and methods are primarily simple getters/setters, delegation to parent, or generated type-casting methods. No evidence of excessive size, complexity, or bloated interface.

The class exhibits excessive size and complexity with 300+ lines, handling multiple responsibilities including bound management, constraint derivation, dependency analysis, and resolution algorithms. It contains numerous private helper methods (findPairSameAs, forEachPairSameAs, forEachPairSameAndSubtype, forEachPairSubtypeAndSubtype, findPairsOfCommonAncestors, buildAllSubsetsOfSize, allSetsWithProperty, etc.) that could be separated into dedicated classes. The deriveImpliedBounds and performResolution methods are overly long and complex, implementing multiple algorithm steps that could be modularized. The class also manages multiple bound types (SameAsBound, SubtypeOfBound, CapturesBound, FalseBound) and their interactions without proper separation of concerns.

The class contains 100+ visit methods implementing the same repetitive hash calculation pattern for each AST node type, resulting in excessive size (over 900 lines) and complexity. All responsibilities for calculating hash codes for every possible AST node type are concentrated in a single class without decomposition into smaller, more cohesive units.

The class exhibits excessive size (over 800 lines) and complexity with multiple responsibilities including method applicability checking, type parameter substitution, variadic parameter handling, lambda type checking, and method selection logic. It contains numerous static helper methods (groupVariadicParamValues, findCommonType, isConflictingLambdaType, groupTrailingArgumentsIntoArray, isAssignableMatchTypeParameters, replaceTypeParam, substituteTypeVariables, inferTypes, etc.) that could be separated into cohesive abstractions. The class has a bloated interface with 15+ public static methods and lacks clear separation of concerns between type resolution, method matching, and generic type handling.

The class delegates substantial responsibility to JavassistMethodLikeDeclarationAdapter, maintains a single primary responsibility of adapting CtMethod to ResolvedMethodDeclaration, has a focused interface implementing only required methods, and shows no signs of excessive size, complexity, or bloated interface.

The class exhibits excessive size and complexity with 100+ lines, handling multiple responsibilities including type resolution, method solving, field collection, ancestor computation, and type conversion. It directly manipulates AST nodes, delegates to multiple helpers (JavaParserTypeAdapter, AstResolutionUtils, SymbolSolver), and contains deprecated public methods indicating bloated interface. The class mixes declaration logic with resolution logic, violating single responsibility principle.

The class has a single responsibility representing primitive types, contains only primitive-specific logic, has a focused interface with minimal methods, and delegates appropriately to its nested enum. The class size is moderate and complexity is low, showing adequate decomposition.

The class is focused on a single, well-defined responsibility: providing a mutable wrapper for a float primitive. It has a minimal interface with only one field, implements standard interfaces (Number, Comparable, Mutable), and its methods are cohesive operations on that single value (get, set, add, subtract, increment, decrement). The size and complexity are appropriate for its purpose, and there is no indication of bloated interface or responsibilities that could be separated.

The class exhibits excessive size and complexity with 35 methods, many performing distinct JIT compilation demonstration tasks (e.g., addVariable, randomBranchTest, intrinsicTest, testSort, testCallChain, testLoopUnrolling). These methods lack cohesive abstraction and could be separated into smaller, focused classes (e.g., BranchTestDemo, IntrinsicDemo, SortDemo, ChainDemo). The class also has a bloated interface with numerous private helper methods (chainA1-4, chainB1-3, chainC1-3, leaf1-4) that are tightly coupled to specific demonstrations rather than representing a unified responsibility.

The class is a focused utility class with 28 static methods that all operate on strings. It demonstrates high cohesion by grouping related string manipulation functions (formatting, padding, parsing, conversion, wrapping, etc.) under a single, well-defined abstraction. The class is not excessively large or complex, and its interface is not bloated; each method has a clear, single responsibility within the domain of string utilities.

The class delegates responsibilities to specialized subclasses (NnOps, MathOps, etc.) through composition, has a single primary responsibility of providing a unified API for TensorFlow operations, and follows the facade pattern to organize operations into logical groups rather than implementing all functionality directly.

The class is small, focused, and cohesive, representing a single abstraction (a character range in source code). It has only two fields, a constructor, and a limited set of operations that are directly related to range manipulation (creation, modification, containment checks, and overlap detection). There is no evidence of excessive size, complexity, or a bloated interface.

The class delegates all formatting responsibilities to FastDatePrinter and all parsing responsibilities to FastDateParser, maintaining a single responsibility of providing a thread-safe facade. It has moderate size, low complexity, and a focused interface that doesn't concentrate multiple responsibilities.

The class has a single, well-defined responsibility of representing and manipulating a 2D bit matrix. It maintains a cohesive set of operations focused on bit manipulation, region operations, rotations, and conversions. The size is reasonable for its domain, and there is no clear separation of concerns that would benefit from decomposition into smaller classes.

The class has a single responsibility of representing and converting Zing log line data. It maintains cohesive state related to compilation events, provides simple getters/setters, and has only three focused conversion methods (toTagQueued, toTagNMethod, toTagTask) that operate on its own data. The class is not excessively large, complex, or bloated, and shows no signs of multiple responsibilities that need decomposition.

The class contains 70+ public static methods performing diverse validation operations (null checks, empty checks, range checks, type checks, pattern matching, state validation) with significant code duplication across overloaded methods. It has a bloated interface with 20+ constant error messages and handles multiple unrelated responsibilities without decomposition into smaller, cohesive abstractions.

The interface defines a single, cohesive visitor abstraction with 100+ methods, which is typical and necessary for the Visitor pattern to cover all AST node types. The size is inherent to its purpose, not due to inadequate decomposition. The interface has a single responsibility: defining visit methods for the AST hierarchy.

The class exhibits excessive size and complexity by combining multiple responsibilities: block management (expandIfNecessary, copyBlocksTo, transferBlocksTo, truncateBlocks, addBlock, getBlock), file I/O operations (write, read, transferFrom, transferTo), file state management (opened, closed, deleted, deleteContents, truncate), and low-level byte manipulation utilities (zero, put, get). It has a bloated interface with 30+ public and package-private methods, handling both high-level file operations and low-level block/byte operations without adequate decomposition into cohesive abstractions.

The class is small and focused, with a single responsibility of managing an array of Codewords within a BoundingBox. It has low complexity, minimal methods, and a narrow interface. No evidence of excessive size, multiple responsibilities, or bloated interface that would require decomposition.

The class has a single, well-defined responsibility (Reed-Solomon encoding), minimal interface (one public constructor and one public method), manageable size, and delegates polynomial operations to the GenericGFPoly class. It maintains internal state (cachedGenerators) appropriately for performance optimization without bloating its interface or complexity.

The interface is well-decomposed into four focused implementations (Passive, Active, Lazy, Disabled) each with single responsibilities. The Active.Resolved inner class appropriately encapsulates its specific logic. The interface and its implementations are cohesive, small in size, and have minimal complexity.

The class is small (under 50 lines), has a single clear responsibility (selecting appropriate HTTP executor), minimal interface (one public static method), and delegates execution to separate executor classes rather than implementing logic itself.

The class is a simple enum with only four constants. It has minimal size, no methods, no complex logic, and a single, well-defined responsibility of representing report stage types. There is no evidence of excessive size, complexity, or bloated interface that would indicate insufficient decomposition.

The class is small (under 100 lines), focused on a single responsibility (a Writer that discards all output), implements only required Writer interface methods with minimal logic, and has no internal complexity or bloated interface that suggests inadequate decomposition.

The class combines UI layout construction, UI component creation, data binding, and data presentation logic within a single class. It handles creation of multiple distinct UI sections (left column, right column, compilation navigator, size info, timing info), manages numerous labels (lblCompileID, lblClass, lblMember, lblAddress, lblBytecodeSize, etc.), and directly implements data formatting and binding logic. These responsibilities could be separated into smaller, cohesive classes such as dedicated UI builders, view components, or presenter classes.

The class is a simple enum with only four constants, one field, one constructor, and two methods. It has a single responsibility of representing QR code error correction levels, minimal complexity, and a focused interface. No evidence of excessive size, bloated interface, or responsibilities that could be separated.

The class is a simple enum that defines encoding hint constants for a barcode library. It has a single responsibility: to enumerate possible hint types. The class is not excessively large (22 constants), has low complexity (no methods or logic), and does not have a bloated interface. Each constant is well-documented but does not introduce separate responsibilities that could be decomposed into smaller abstractions.

The class handles multiple distinct responsibilities: applying cookies to requests (applyCookiesToRequest), converting URLs to URIs (asUri), storing cookies from responses (storeCookies), and parsing cookie strings (parseCookie). These operations lack a cohesive abstraction and could be separated into dedicated classes for request cookie handling, response cookie handling, and URI conversion.

The class is small and focused, containing only a constructor and a single overridden method. It has minimal complexity, a narrow interface, and serves a clear, specific purpose of handling symbol resolution for ArrayAccessExpr nodes while preventing recursive access issues.

The class is small, focused, and has a single responsibility: implementing PrivilegedAction<String> to read a system property. It has minimal complexity (one field, one constructor, one method), a narrow interface, and represents a well-defined abstraction that does not require further decomposition.

The class is small, simple, and focused. It implements an interface and defines only one static final field. There is no evidence of excessive size, complexity, or bloated interface. The abstraction is clear and appropriately decomposed.

The interface is small and focused with a single method. The nested Factory interface and Default enum are cohesive abstractions that separate concerns appropriately. The class shows good decomposition with minimal size and complexity.

The class is small, focused, and cohesive, containing only three simple constructors that delegate to the parent RuntimeException. It represents a single, well-defined abstraction (a runtime exception for clone failures) without excessive size, complexity, or bloated interface.

The class is small (only two fields and one constructor), has a clear single responsibility (meta-model for TypeParameter), inherits core functionality from ReferenceTypeMetaModel, and shows no signs of excessive size, complexity, or bloated interface.

The class has a single, well-defined responsibility: representing a data block and providing a static method to de-interleave raw codewords into blocks. It is small (two fields, three methods), has minimal interface, and the complex de-interleaving logic is contained within a single static factory method appropriate for its purpose.

The class is a simple enum with only two values (MEMBER and STATIC). It implements multiple interfaces but has minimal, cohesive functionality: a mask field, getMask(), getRange(), isDefault(), and isStatic(). The class is small, focused on representing ownership modifiers, and shows no signs of excessive size, complexity, or bloated interface.

The class is small, focused, and has a single responsibility: creating parser instances based on a type. It delegates all parsing logic to separate classes (HotSpotLogParser, J9LogParser, ZingLogParser), showing adequate decomposition. No excessive size, complexity, or bloated interface is present.

The class is appropriately modularized as a decorator for OutputStream with a single responsibility: delegating operations while providing hooks for extension. It has a focused interface (only essential write methods plus close/flush), moderate size, and clear cohesion. The added writeRepeat methods are logical extensions of the core delegation responsibility. The Builder inner class is appropriately nested for construction.
